Tameh Polska Sp ZOO Announces Senior Leadership Change in Electric Utilities Sector

Tameh Polska Sp ZOO, a key player in Poland’s electric utilities sector, has announced a significant change in its senior management team. Effective this week, Anna Kowalska has been appointed as the company’s new Chief Operating Officer, succeeding Marek Nowak, who is stepping down after more than a decade in the role.

The appointment comes as Tameh Polska Sp ZOO continues to focus on modernizing its operations and enhancing energy efficiency across its facilities. The company, which provides power and heating solutions to industrial clients in the Silesian region, has been at the forefront of several major infrastructure projects in recent years.

“We are delighted to welcome Ms. Kowalska to the management board. Her extensive experience in the utilities sector and proven leadership skills will be invaluable as we pursue our strategic objectives,” said Piotr Zieliński, Chief Executive Officer of Tameh Polska Sp ZOO, in a statement on Monday. “We also want to express our deepest gratitude to Mr. Nowak for his exceptional service and dedication, which have played a crucial role in the company’s growth.”

Anna Kowalska previously held senior positions at regional energy firms, where she led initiatives related to grid modernization and renewable integration. Industry analysts have noted that her appointment signals Tameh Polska Sp ZOO’s ongoing commitment to innovation and sustainability.

“Tameh Polska’s decision to bring in a COO with a strong background in energy transition is a positive step,” said Ewa Jankowska, analyst at the Polish Energy Association. “This is especially important as the sector adapts to new regulatory requirements and an increased focus on green technologies.”

The transition is expected to proceed smoothly, with Mr. Nowak remaining as an advisor during the handover period. No changes to operational activities or service delivery have been announced.

Local union representatives have welcomed the appointment, expressing optimism about continued collaboration. “We look forward to working with Ms. Kowalska to ensure stable employment and safe working conditions for our members,” said Tomasz Maj, head of the Silesian Utility Workers’ Union.

The leadership change marks a new chapter for Tameh Polska Sp ZOO as it prepares for future challenges and opportunities in Poland’s evolving energy landscape.
